How to Use Valid on Android and iPhone

By the Valid team · Updated September 14, 2026

Valid — Compliment Classmates is available through its official iPhone app and through its web app on Android. Use the links below to reach the right product.

On iPhone

  1. Open Valid — Compliment Classmates on the App Store.
  2. Check the app name and developer, RevueAI, Inc.
  3. Download or open the app and follow the account prompts shown on your device.

Valid is free to download, with optional in-app purchases. The App Store lists current compatibility, and the app shows current purchase benefits and prices.

On Android

  1. Open Valid’s official Android web-app route in Chrome.
  2. Follow the Install Valid prompt when it is available.
  3. If the installer is not available yet, open Chrome’s menu and look for Install app or Add to Home screen, as the on-page instructions explain.
  4. Complete the browser’s confirmation, then open Valid from the icon and follow the account prompts.

Browser labels and installation availability vary by device and browser version. If you opened the link inside another app, try opening it in Chrome. If the install option still does not appear, send support your device model, browser version, and a screenshot of the screen.

Is the Android version an APK download?

The Android route linked here is a web app installed through the browser. These instructions do not require downloading an APK from a third-party website. A different app called Valid in another store is not necessarily Valid — Compliment Classmates.

Do I need to find Valid on Google Play?

No Google Play download is needed to use Valid on Android. Open Valid’s official web app in Chrome and follow the installation steps above. You do not need another compliment app to use Valid on an Android phone.

The App Store listing linked here is for the iPhone app by RevueAI, Inc. An iPhone download size or an App Store link on a directory page does not identify an Android APK. For current access options, use the buttons on validapp.lol.

You can always start at the official Valid homepage and use its iPhone or Android button. Check the full app name, developer, and domain when following a download link.

Already have an account?

Use the sign-in option shown in the app. If you cannot get past a particular screen, contact support@validapp.lol and describe the step that failed. Never send a password or one-time verification code to support.

What should I know before joining?

Valid is for students ages 13 and older. It offers positive polls and ways to connect with people in school communities. The iPhone app and web app can differ in interface and feature availability; follow the options actually shown on your device.

The parent FAQ explains contacts, moderation, reveal features, and purchases. If you arrived because of a text, read the message explanation: receiving a text does not mean you have already created an account.
